preconditions.description: The number of intervals is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= interval[0] <= interval[1] <= 1000 for interval in intervals)
preconditions.description: Each interval is a pair of integers (x, y) where 0 <= x <= y <= 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(merged_interval[0] <= merged_interval[1] for merged_interval in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each merged interval has a valid range (start <= end).

postconditions.expression: all(not any(merged_interval[0] < interval[0] < merged_interval[1] or merged_interval[0] < interval[1] < merged_interval[1] for interval in intervals) for merged_interval in return_value)
postconditions.description: No merged interval overlaps with any original interval.

postconditions.expression: all(merged_interval[0] == min(interval[0] for interval in intervals if interval[0] <= merged_interval[1] and interval[1] >= merged_interval[0]) for merged_interval in return_value)
postconditions.description: The start of each merged interval is the minimum start of all overlapping intervals.

postconditions.expression: all(merged_interval[1] == max(interval[1] for interval in intervals if interval[0] <= merged_interval[1] and interval[1] >= merged_interval[0]) for merged_interval in return_value)
postconditions.description: The end of each merged interval is the maximum end of all overlapping intervals.
The merged intervals are sorted by their start times.
